title: Telegram uploader linking (optional)
description: Add a user-facing flow to link an existing magic-link uploader account to a Telegram sender (avoid auto-provision tg-<id>@telegram.local users), and optionally restrict uploads to linked users only.

title: Convex migration for realtime voting and user flows
description: Refactor the app to use Convex for voting, realtime leaderboard updates, and user signup/profile-related flows while keeping Postgres available for non-voting future use.

title: Configure Prettier to support Svelte files
description: Running npx prettier --check web/src/components/VoteModule.svelte fails with: No parser could be inferred. Add required Prettier Svelte support (plugin/config) so .svelte files can be formatted and checked in local/CI workflows.

title: Purge stale toplist IDs and diagnose source
description: Remove stale image IDs that render as not found/processing on toplist, then identify why IDs remained after image deletion (DB vs Convex mismatch) and document fix.

title: Create comments on images
description: Add support for users to create comments on images, including data model, API/mutation endpoint, basic validation, and UI entry/display flow.

title: Create Postgres-to-Convex migration/backfill for existing voting and user data
description: Add one-off backfill tooling and verification checks to move existing vote/user data to Convex without losing referential consistency.

title: Enable profile editing and fix profile vote count
description: Profile page should allow editing user details (alias), and vote count should include both authenticated votes and historical cookie-hash votes for the logged-in user.

title: Fix Convex vote mutation OCC failures under concurrent load
description: Realtime validation shows POST /api/v1/votes fails heavily under 100 concurrent users due to Convex OptimisticConcurrencyControlFailure while patching imageRatings. Implement retry/serialization strategy so concurrent votes on hot images do not fail and p95 latency can meet target.
close_reason: Implemented queued vote writes with worker serialization; validation now passes 100-concurrent load and correctness checks.

title: Graceful API fallback when Convex realtime is unreachable
description: Mobile/tunnel clients can fail Convex realtime due localhost/mixed-content config, which hid Fresh+Top and Toplist sections. Fall back to API data and keep sections visible with status messaging.

title: Add corny winner animation for A/B vote selections
description: Implement a fun, intentionally corny celebration animation when a user picks the winning image in the A/B voting module (e.g., brief burst/confetti/stamp effect), while keeping vote flow snappy and avoiding layout shift on mobile and desktop.

title: Migrate user signup and profile records to Convex
description: Store and read user signup/profile records from Convex; keep auth integration intact and map auth identities to Convex user documents.

title: Fix mobile Fresh+Top mix hydration reliability
description: HomeFeed on homepage uses client:visible and appears not to initialize reliably on mobile. Switch to eager client hydration for consistent loading and verify.

title: Set up Convex project integration and env wiring
description: Add Convex client/server setup, configure environment.local keys, and verify app can query Convex in local and production modes.

title: Fix Convex backfill reset read-limit failures
description: convex/backfill.ts resetData collects and deletes too many docs in one mutation and fails with read limit 4096 on larger datasets. Make reset/backfill scalable (pagination/chunking across multiple invocations) so npm run convex:backfill succeeds.

title: Improve image detail navigation with modal popup and explicit close/back
description: Make image opening/navigation more intuitive: when clicking an image, present it in a popup/modal-style detail view using modern CSS patterns (responsive, accessible overlay, focus handling), and include a clear X close button that returns users to the previous page/state. Preserve deep-link support for direct image URLs.

title: Migrate voting read/write path from Postgres to Convex
description: Replace vote mutations and vote queries with Convex functions, including concurrency-safe vote updates for high write volume.

title: Fix current Prettier formatting violations
description: Run Prettier checks after enabling Svelte support, apply formatting to all files that fail, and verify format:check passes.

title: Refine upload form UX: progressive fields + playful file picker CTA
description: On the upload page, hide title and description inputs until a file is selected. Replace the current small 'Browse' file input affordance with a larger, more playful and obvious call-to-action while preserving accessibility and mobile usability.

title: Show uploader alias in image details
description: When opening image details, display the alias of the user who uploaded the image. Add alias support to user data model and flow it through API/UI.

title: Require alias in Convex userProfiles schema
description: Now that backfill is stable, make userProfiles.alias required in Convex schema and verify deploy succeeds without legacy rows missing alias.

title: Fix lint scope/config for TS and generated build artifacts
description: npm run lint currently reports hundreds of pre-existing errors because ESLint is scanning generated dist/.astro files and lacks TS-aware parser/env configuration for API/Convex sources. Add proper ignore patterns and language settings so lint gates reflect source code quality.

title: Mobile-first voting UI with hamburger nav
description: Improve mobile UX by reducing header footprint with a hamburger menu and prioritizing A/B voting interactions (clear tap targets, mobile-specific vote hints, tighter spacing).

title: Fix doubled /api path in single-origin gateway
description: After gateway rollout, frontend builds /api/api/v1/* URLs. Set default public API base to empty root and adjust component defaults so requests target /api/v1/* correctly.

title: Improve A/B matchup load speed and eliminate layout shift
description: Optimize the A/B voting module so next matchup appears near-instantly (target sub-500ms perceived load, ideally preloaded) and ensure zero layout shift while loading/replacing images. Add stable placeholders/skeleton dimensions and update transitions to avoid content jumping on both mobile and desktop.

title: Remove empty test images from database
description: Identify and delete empty/bad image records introduced during testing, including dependent rows if needed, and verify remaining dataset integrity.

title: Implement realtime leaderboard and gallery updates via Convex subscriptions
description: Refactor toplist/gallery data fetching to use Convex reactive queries so vote totals and rankings update live without polling.

title: Telegram group photo uploads
description: Allow members of an allowed private Telegram group to post photos that are ingested by a bot webhook, stored in MinIO, processed via existing image queue, and attributed to the sender (create/update uploader user keyed by telegram_user_id). Add env-gated security (allowed chat IDs + optional secret token) and tests.
close_reason: Implemented Telegram webhook ingest + attribution + docs + tests

title: Fix missing winner animation visibility in fast-prefetch path
description: Winner animation state is reset before paint when prefetched matchup swaps immediately. Ensure a minimum visible animation window while preserving snappy A/B flow.

title: Add Tinder-style swipe voting on mobile
description: Implement horizontal swipe gesture on mobile for A/B matchup voting with visual feedback and thresholded submit, while preserving tap and keyboard input.

title: Add API tests for profile endpoints
description: Add automated tests for GET/PATCH /api/v1/auth/profile, including alias validation, persistence behavior, and profile stats response shape.

title: Single-origin dev gateway for Cloudflare tunnel testing
description: Route web, API, and assets behind one origin for local/tunnel testing. Implement Astro dev proxy for /api -> localhost:8787 and /assets -> localhost:9010, update web defaults to relative API path, and document usage to avoid env churn when tunnel URLs rotate.

title: Add profile page with signup date and activity counts
description: When a logged-in user clicks their profile label, open a profile management page showing signed-up date, total votes cast, and total images uploaded.

title: Add load and correctness validation for realtime voting
description: Define and run tests for realtime behavior under ~100 concurrent users, including leaderboard consistency and update latency targets.
close_reason: Added automated realtime voting validation harness and executed 100-concurrent run; captured latency and consistency metrics plus failure signatures.
